messages:
acme.engineer: Hey team — applied trial promo ACME-TRIAL-2026 and made a few generate calls (~24k tokens total) yesterday but dashboard still shows full 5000 trial credits. API responses show usage in the body. Request id: req_abc123. Can you investigate?

rachael.support: Thanks — can you paste account id + an example request/response and approx time?

acme.engineer: acct: acme-inc-42, req: req_abc123, time: 2026-03-16T22:12:04Z. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME..." \\
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-small","input":"summarize...","idempotency_key":"idemp-1"}'
```
Response:
```
{
  "id":"resp_789",
  "output":"...",
  "usage":{"prompt_tokens":12000,"completion_tokens":12000,"total_tokens":24000}
}
```
Headers: x-request-id: req_abc123, x-account-balance: 5000

devin.billing: Looking now. Were any of these streaming requests? Any retries from client?

acme.engineer: Not streaming. Client retried once after a client-side timeout (30s). We set idempotency_key and got 200 with same response id on retry.

maya.sre: Quick check on ledger — I don't see any consumption events for acme-inc-42 around that window. Ran:
```
SELECT * FROM billing_events WHERE account='acme-inc-42' AND created_at > '2026-03-16' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;
```
Result: only promo grant rows, no consumption rows for total_tokens ~24000.

rachael.support: Hmm. @devin.billing can you check the finalize_queue / finalize_worker logs for req_abc123?

devin.billing: Checked logs — finalize_worker hit a transient DB deadlock at ~22:12 for req_abc123:
```
ERROR finalize_worker req=req_abc123 sqlstate=40P01 deadlock detected: canceling statement
```
The worker retried but I don't see a consumption row linked to that request id. Nightly reconcile exists; I'll trigger a one-off reconcile and then follow up.

ops-bot: one-off reconcile job started: reconcile-2026-03-17-01 for account acme-inc-42 (triggered by @devin.billing).

maya.sre: Suspect root cause: async billing finalizer can race with idempotent retries — system returned 200 to the client before ledger write was durably persisted. Deadlock + retry path left us with no committed consumption despite the client seeing success. Repro steps: force a lock in finalize_worker, send identical requests with same idempotency_key, observe missing ledger write when retry path cancels.

devin.billing: Mitigation: I'll perform a manual ledger insert for the missing consumption events and recalc balance for acme-inc-42 now. We'll also harden finalize_worker to re-enqueue on deadlock and improve visibility/metrics.

rachael.support: I'll notify the customer: we'll apply a manual consumption (-24000 tokens) while we finish the RCA and patch.

acme.engineer: Thanks — can you confirm when the -24000 delta will be visible? Also will this affect our trial quota or billing?

devin.billing: You should see a -24000 delta within the hour, with note "manual reconcile - finalize deadlock". Trial quota will reflect the deduction (no charge; still within trial). Sorry for the inconvenience. :handshake:

maya.sre: Postmortem actions: add tombstone record for failed finalize attempts, increase retry/backoff on DB deadlocks, and add idempotency verification during ledger writes. ETA for patch + deploy: 48h.

rachael.support: Assigning follow-up to @devin.billing and @maya.sre. We'll reopen if anything else shows up.

acme.engineer: Appreciate the quick response — will monitor the account and confirm once I see the delta.
